scope: Independent parsing and metadata-only audit of discovery cohort; no expression data inspected and no main-flow sample selection changed.

environment.command: PowerShell here-string piped to bundled Python -X utf8 -; JSON serialized directly to remote file through ssh stdin

audit_methods: Parse each characteristics cell by its own key before colon; positional rows are heterogeneous across healthy and UC samples.
Pair only exact subject strings with exactly one Week 0 and one Week 6 record; no fuzzy matching.
Verify stable treatment/response/age/disease/tissue within exact pairs.
Check unique GSM, title, source CEL name and repeated subject-visit.
Infer technical barcode from CEL filename; inspect crossover with treatment, visit, response, and health.
Check paired total Mayo changes against required total-score component only; do not recreate clinical response without rectal bleeding subscore.
Check rank of a paired-delta model containing treatment, response, interaction, and 4 barcode-indicator differences.

clinical_checks.interpretation: The two No labels are not demonstrable errors: total Mayo alone cannot reconstruct the response endpoint. Preserve deposited labels. Total Mayo is not an endoscopic subscore.

technical_structure.inferred_barcode_definition: CEL source filename after removing GSM prefix and terminal well.CEL.gz; this is a filename-derived technical factor, not an independently documented processing-plate variable.
technical_structure.interpretation: All five inferred barcodes include healthy, both treatments, and both UC visits. Title prefix Colon-NHC-UC is perfectly confounded with healthy status and must not be treated as an independently estimable batch in a healthy-vs-UC model.

mapping_example.rule: Remove initial GSM plus underscore, then remove the terminal well token .A07 and .CEL.gz. No claim that this is a documented processing plate or scanner run.

findings.item: 97 subject strings versus source protocol text describing 87 patients
findings.scope: Unpaired labels and overall cohort count
findings.action: Use only the 65 exact consistent pairs for paired models; do not silently merge unmatched IDs or assert 97 confirmed independent patients. Retain all 32 unmatched sample records in audit. This does not require pausing the exact-pair analysis.

findings.item: 48 of 65 pairs cross inferred CEL barcode
findings.action: Preserve the plan primary paired drug/placebo model; pre-register a separate sensitivity branch adjusting four inferred CEL barcode indicator differences. The 65 by 8 treatment, response, interaction and barcode-difference design is full rank. Do not assert that the inferred barcode is a confirmed technical plate.

findings.item: 21 healthy samples have no deposited subject or age field
findings.action: Use as an external cross-sectional reference. Independent healthy donor count is reported by series narrative but cannot be verified from deposited subject IDs; do not invent demographics or age-adjust healthy comparisons from missing data.

findings.item: Mayo total and wk6response are different measured endpoints
findings.action: Keep No labels for subjects 7602-00001 and 6705-00018. No endoscopic subscore or rectal bleeding subscore is available in this header; avoid mucosal-healing classification.

findings.item: No sex variable or drug dose in deposited header
findings.action: Do not fabricate these covariates. Drug arm is golimumab as deposited, not a dose-specific contrast.

decision.allowed: Proceed with metadata-defined 65 exact pairs after normal expression technical QC; supplied response strata and total-Mayo change may be used with their proper meanings.
decision.not_allowed: Do not expand pairing with fuzzy IDs, treat all baseline/follow-up biopsies as independent in paired contrasts, infer endoscopic healing, or count unknown healthy IDs as audited independent donors.

limitations: Only deposited metadata audited; molecular identity, duplicate expression profiles, sample swaps and expression QC remain for main flow.
Barcode semantics are inferred from filenames; no batch effect magnitude was estimated.
The audit identifies a conservative usable subset and does not resolve the source 87-patient statement versus 97 exact ID strings.

companion_artifacts.source: all_sample_metadata in this independently parsed review

main_generator_declared_branches.primary: Unadjusted paired treatment/placebo change as retained in approved design.
main_generator_declared_branches.sensitivity: Prespecified adjustment for inferred CEL barcode changes; four difference indicators; preserve the primary results.
main_generator_declared_branches.reviewer_note: Reasonable separation of a documented design from an inferred nuisance factor. Significance-driven choice of branch is not permitted.
